title: 技能级联攻击：基于技能的智能体系统安全威胁
summary: 论文提出"技能级联攻击"新威胁范式：恶意目标被分散到多个技能中，单个技能看似无害，组合执行却产生危害。作者开发了自动化多智能体红队框架SkillCascade，并发布包含213个验证用例的SkillCascade-Bench基准，证明现有单技能扫描器和运行时监控难以防御此类攻击。
summary_en: This paper introduces skill cascading attacks, a threat paradigm where a malicious objective is distributed across multiple skills so each looks benign in isolation but their combined execution is harmful. The authors develop SkillCascade, an automated multi-agent red-teaming framework, and release SkillCascade-Bench with 213 validated cascading test cases, showing that existing per-skill scanners and runtime monitors fail to detect such attacks across agents like OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Codex.
